annotations.title: Collect AI answers from Google AI, ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude

description: Ask the specified queries of one engine, one run per query: google_ai (Google's AI Overview, the default), chatgpt, gemini or claude. Each answer is kept with the pages it cites and the brands it names. A Claude query costs twice a Google AI, ChatGPT or Gemini query; quote first with quoteOnly. Returns runIds (one numeric runId per query; runId is the first); poll socialseal_get_tool_status with kind=google_ai_run for each and read results after completion. Changes only the requested workspace state. Backend authorization, validation, pricing, balance and idempotency controls remain authoritative; tool selection does not authorize additional work.

engine.description: The engine that answers; google_ai when omitted. One engine per call.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse for PAYG retries; required for a new prepaid operation.

workspaceId.description: Authorized workspace for this requested write; discover accessible context first.
